The linked rmw_fastrtps issues reproduce the symptom with no MoveIt involvement, e.g. #650 with a plain rclcpp publisher on a MultiThreadedExecutor ("Running this simple example with a `MultiThreadedExecutor` eventually causes a deadlock (typically within a few seconds). A lost waitset notification in the middleware's own logic occurs with any correct application; it depends on no assumption between MoveIt and Fast DDS. The MoveIt maintainer's hypothesis "There is a chance the problem is the code in MoveIt and we are not using ROS correctly in some way" was not borne out: the resolution changed no MoveIt code.
